QUOTE: "Macros win over runtime setup (`platform.c:16-19`)." and "Leave both macros undefined, then call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates compile-time macros from runtime function pointers, but it never says they are mutually exclusive. It only says the macros take precedence over runtime setup, and the mutual-exclusion rule it cites is between `*_MACRO` and `STD_*`, which is a different pairing.
